error: Grainset `txn_by_grain` cannot compute `quantity_per_target`: either the children that serve the names it reads share no keyset that maps them together (a Metric without `agg:` needs one, and so does the formula grain of a Metric with `agg:`), or a child that gives a value maps a Dimension of the formula grain coarser than the finest granularity at which such a child maps it
